notes.title: New DLC! The Culinary Diaries
notes.notes:
Unbeknownst to Antonia, a simple-minded anthropologist, a craving for elaborate meals had been simmering in her town. This realization sparks her quest to visit neighboring towns, learn their recipes, and bring them back to satisfy her community’s needs—and their appetites. Welcome to Volume VIII of Outlanders Chronicles: “The Culinary Diaries”.

Her involvement in the affairs of these towns teaches her the profound role food plays in a community, where she learns that, even without words, a well-prepared meal can serve as a helping hand, a pat on the back, or even a warm hug.

In addition to the 6-level campaign, this update contains new customization options for Sandbox mode, new buildings and recipes, and 5 new playable leaders.

notes.title: NEW DLC! A Taste for Trouble
notes.notes:
Our journey brings us to a stark landscape, where a crime comes to the attention of one of the region’s brightest minds, the famous Detective Quan. During this journey, he will meet two idiosyncratic leaders with their own agendas, turning what initially seemed like an open-and-shut case into the highlight of his detective career.

The newest and seventh DLC, “A Taste for Trouble”, is a story about people's secret lives and their aspirations. Is everyone who they say they are? Will he find the truth or fail trying? There will be no question unanswered, no stone unturned, and no level uncompleted!

In addition to the 6-level campaign, this DLC contains new customization options for Sandbox mode, new buildings, and 3 new playable leaders.

notes.title: Outlanders: Chronicles Vol. VI 'Wandering Stars' - NEW DLC!
notes.notes:
In the midst of an expedition, a nomad community is led to a safe haven by a comet. The town considers its presence a good omen and celebrates every time it visits throughout the generations. However, one fateful day, the comet doesn’t appear, leaving them to helplessly try to stay together despite the absence of what once bound them.

“Wandering Stars” is the sixth DLC for Outlanders, in which we witness the rise and fall of a city and the lives of those who once were a part of it. Prepare for a region wide identity crisis surrounded by aegean-like landscapes and architecture.

notes.title: Update Notes For May 12
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] We rewrote several mission objectives that were incorrect or unclear. 
[*] We fixed a bug that allowed to activate opposite decrees at the same time. 
[*] Fixed an error with saves that made the game stuck at the Loading screen. We added an automatic backup for all game saves. 
[*] We fixed several visual bugs when changing the mouse to controller. 
[*] Fixed an error in Steam that generated issues when saving and loading from the Cloud. 
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Now, tips show up displayed every time. 
[*] When playing sandbox now you can see the Map Seed from the pause menu and you can copy it clicking on it. 
[*] We added the option to hide the Warnings on Settings. 
[*] Now, when starting a Sandbox game, Stockpiles are added if you need them for the initial resources. 
[*] We improved the grid shown when building. 
[*] We temporarily deactivated the function “Restore” in a building that is being Recycled. 
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] We added the possibility to use Vsync.
[*] The game can now also run to 60+ fps. 
[/list]

[h2]Sandbox New Features[/h2]

[h3]Summary[/h3]
We added a button when finishing a Sandbox game that allows you to see how many Building and Resources you had. This will help you compare your final results with other players. 

[h3]Time Limit[/h3]
Under the tab “Advanced Settings” you can now choose a time limit in days. 

When playing a game with Time Limit, you are shown a notification with a counter of how many days are left to finish the game. When the counter reaches 0, the game ends. 

This allows players to compete and find out who can make more buildings and gather more resources among other things. 

[h3]Custom Rules[/h3]
In “Advanced Settings” you can set up and play with your own set of rules. These can dramatically change the game mechanics and overall experience. 

These are some of the options you can customize:
[list]
[*] No happiness loss: Outlanders can’t lose happiness. 
[*] No hunger: the Outlanders never go hungry.
[*] No building costs: you can build buildings without using resources.
[*] Instant building: you can place and build a building instantly. 
[*] No aging: the Outlanders never die of old age, they get older though.
[*] No concerns: you can deactivate the concerns you want (for example: no Gastronomy). 
[/list]

notes.title: Outlanders review: a charming town builder with a hidden sense of humour
notes.notes:
I'm the sort of person that likes the idea of a rural, low-tech lifestyle, where you have a lovely little wooden house and know all your neighbours, and all your food is locally sourced from the farm down the road - but I'm self-aware enough to know that I'd hate it in practice. In the case of new town builder Outlanders, I'd have to share a house with five other people, the farmer just died of old age, and my leader wanders around doing nothing while occasionally issuing edicts forcing me to have children. But at least there's a chance of pumpkin pie.

notes.title: Meet the leaders: Gerald, Earl & Ronald
notes.notes:
The Outlands are a place where everyone can walk their own path and choose the community they like the most.  We can happily say that variety is something we can find in every corner of this world, but something always caught our eye. There’s three towns that have something in common: their leaders! A set of triplets rule three different towns each one of them has their own way of doing it. 

Now, let’s meet them!

First up: Gerald!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43068490/c991345dfa38b85db4efdc20ed5d78e5dfc35bcd.png[/img]

Free spirited, Gerald is someone who certainly loves a good party. He aspires to make his town the most fun out of all the Outlands and our sources tell us that is mostly true. A true friend of his people, he works hard to give them what they need and always makes them happy. 

The triplets are all completely different, and Gerald is proud to call himself the fun one. 

Next: Earl!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43068490/20854f07a3c0fdd7d734d2c0a835dd4918f63c0a.png[/img]

The toughest out of the bunch. He has gone through tough times, but this hasn’t killed his spirit. He is a dedicated leader that got his town through thick and thin. 

He has the reputation of being the “smart one” out of the triplets. He is strict but compassionate and always looks after his people. 

Finally: Ronald!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43068490/dcf06972e1d660caa4fcc51c21710918e65e9030.png[/img]

The “third twin” might be the least popular, but it is certainly one of the firsts in our hearts! He might be trying to prove his worth to his brothers 90% of the time, but this doesn’t mean he is not a good leader. Always trying his best, he gives his people what they want. 

[b]More leaders are coming soon![/b]

You can join our [b]Discord[/b] to chat about all things Outlanders [url=https://discord.gg/MkQD8fp]here[/url]!

notes.title: Meet the leaders: Fjorda, Jebediah & Bjorg
notes.notes:
Different communities call the Outlands their home and each one of them has their own leader. They make the calls and decisions for their people, always looking to thrive and prosper. 

Their towns are set all around the Outlands and they all have their own feel, culture and characteristics. Today we will be learning about Fjorda, Jebediah (aka the bread man) and Bjorg and their doings around their towns. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43068490/bbf99504a981c29a8884684623bf8ee073c4014a.png[/img]

First up, [b]Fjorda[/b], one of Outlanders’ most epic leaders. This viking queen has been all over the world looking for a place to settle with her peers. They’ve faced setbacks and hardships but they pulled through it all. 

Who is Fjorda?
Fjorda is a natural born leader, a fierce woman who is not afraid to stand up for what she believes in. Through the years, and thanks to her charming personality, she has won enough followers to build her own town. As impressive as that seems, she has also managed to travel the world and create a wonderful community. 

Following this impressive strong leader, we have [b]Jebediah[/b]! 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43068490/60bc3d798cc7c80ae876a84bf827ed0be4ab339c.png[/img]

He is a little weird, but in a good way. He has mastered the art of baking and has built his town using bread as primary resource. His journey across the Outlands has been bumpy, but somehow he managed to prosper and hold the record for biggest structure made of bread (he really didn’t have any competitors). His town is the place to be for festivities, they are famous for holding a peculiar, unique and equally fun festival, you should really think about making a visit! 

Today’s last spotlight goes to [b]Bjorg[/b]!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43068490/ea25cff1ed49b15d98417516f2b2e8a4e1634cda.png[/img]

This chill dude works around his town like he’s got all the time in the world. He’s the number one fan of the simple life, all that fancy stuff is not suited for a guy like him. The vibe he pulls off has made him make a lot of friends from all over the Outlands. He usually hosts big meet ups and welcomes everyone with a simple yet fulfilling meal. The thing to remember about Bjorg is that, no matter what, you will have a place to stay and a warm meal under his roof. 

What do you think about these leaders? We’ll soon be meeting them! 

You can join our Discord to chat about all things Outlanders [url=https://discord.gg/MkQD8fp]here[/url]!
